name: Dan Shipper
role: ceo @every | the only subscription you need to stay at the edge of AI
summary:
using posthog inside of codex
it is SO MUCH better to browse posthog inside of codex—codex can write queries and see the results, and it makes our collaboration extremely seamless. codex can also kick off agents that write PRs or run production DB requests to back up insights
summaryEn:
using posthog inside of codex
it is SO MUCH better to browse posthog inside of codex—codex can write queries and see the results, and it makes our collaboration extremely seamless. codex can also kick off agents that write PRs or run production DB requests to back up insights
analysis: Dan 这条最有意思的是把分析工具直接搬进 Codex，连写查询、看结果、拉 agent 提 PR 或跑生产库都串起来了。作为 Every 的 CEO，他关注的是协作效率，所以这里展示的不是单点能力，而是“人和 agent 共用一个操作面”的复合工作流。

name: Dan Shipper
role: ceo @every | the only subscription you need to stay at the edge of AI
summary:
we might need to coin a new term:
Codex-native
Cowork-native
Cursor-native
apps designed to be used inside of the in-app browser of your agent of choice. the agent can use it and you can use it too, full context is shared, and you can both see what the other is doing.
huge

we might need to coin a new term:

apps designed to be used inside of the in-app browser of your agent of choice. the agent can use it and you can use it too, full context is shared, and you can both see what the other is doing.
huge

analysis: 郭宇这条非常直给，核心不是吵架，而是拒绝把持续做产品、持续公开进展解释成“制造焦虑”。他一贯是高频实践派，所以这里是在划清边界：如果你不接受这种更新节奏，最好互相取关，而不是用情绪框架替代讨论。

summaryEn: 让大家享受最后一年意义的工作，Chad Hurley 写的这句话是多么有诗意的一个说法，为什么在中文语境里就变成了贩卖焦虑和断章取义？语文到底是谁教的？我认为技术主义者本质上都是反人类主义者，他们不断 push

name: 今日总结
role: Builder Daily
summary: 今天这批 Builder 内容里，最强的主线不是“模型又涨了多少分”，而是大家开始认真处理 agent 落地后的基础设施和界面问题。上半场在聊 Mesa、GitHub rate limit、Codex 内跑 PostHog、Codex-native 应用，说明文件系统、API 配额、共享上下文和可执行界面已经成了新瓶颈；下半场则在聊 Claude 接专业创意工具、SVG 和动画分镜这类可编辑资产，AI 正从生成结果转向嵌进真实软件链路。与此同时，内容分发和个人品牌也没有退场，不少 builder 仍在用课程、短内容和数据可视化放大影响力。整体看，今天的信号很明确：谁先把 agent 接进稳定工作流，谁就更可能把模型红利变成持续产出。
